description: This file defines the GrainDirectoryOptions class which encapsulates configuration options related to grain directory caching strategies in Orleans. It includes enums for cache types, various configurable properties with default values, and some deprecated settings.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration options for grain directory caching strategies including cache type, size, TTLs, and delays.

methods.name: CachingStrategyType
methods.description: Enumeration of cache strategies: None, LRU, Adaptive (deprecated), and Custom.
